terms_note: '1、联系对应AM，提供需开通Marketing API 的账户id和账户名称 2、AM进行申请 3、申请通过后，AM提供appId、appKey等应用信息'; token create / refresh endpoints; public parameters on every request. Rate limits: not stated. Free.

discovery.auth: token (appId / appKey issued by the account manager → token create / refresh; public parameters on each call)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Mi Ads Marketing API + Reporting API) Confidence: **high** — official docs read.
auth: 1. Contact the account manager (AM) with the account id + name to enable Marketing API; AM applies; on approval the AM provides `appId`, `appKey` and other app info.
2. Token: create (`token创建` endpoint with appId/appKey) and refresh (`更新token`).
3. Set the public parameters (公共参数) on each call, then call the ad interfaces.

adapter.terms: 小米营销 (Xiaomi Ads global) Marketing API (https://global.e.mi.com/doc/zh/marketing_api_guide.html): an access token is created with POST /foreign/token/createToken {appId, appKey} (result.accessToken, expireDate); every call sends the common parameters access_token, timestamp and a per-request unique uid in the Cookie ('参数位置: Cookie'). Answers {code (0 = 成功), message, result}; code 10004 = accountId未授权, 20002 = 接口调用频率过高. Access is opened per account through the Xiaomi AM.

me.note: 2.4 获取国家列表 (GET /foreign/marketing/region/countryList, no parameters) returns {code, result:[{geoType, id, name}]} for a valid token, so it verifies the app credentials without an account id. The earlier probe (campaign/list with page/pageSize only) is refused before authentication with code 100500 "Required List parameter 'accountIds' is not present" (auth audit 2026-09-26).

list_campaigns.note: 1.1 获取广告计划 (GET /foreign/marketing/campaign/list with page, pageSize, accountIds): records {accountId, campaignId, name, dayBudget (美元×100000, left in raw), campaignType (1 应用下载, 2 H5, 3 再营销)}; result.total/pages give the paging. account_id is sent as accountIds. No status or dates are returned.

update_budget.note: The API has no campaign update call; budgets are edited on 广告组 (ad groups) with 2.3 修改广告组 (POST /foreign/marketing/group/update {groupIds, dayBudget}), so campaign_id here is a groupId (from 2.1 获取广告组, GET /foreign/marketing/group/list). daily_budget is in US dollars and sent as dayBudget in 美元×100000. This spends money; currency is ignored (USD).

not_offered.list_accounts: No account-listing call is documented: the guide covers token creation, common parameters, 广告计划 (list/add), 广告组 (list/add/update, regions, media) and 广告创意 (list/add/update, upload) (https://global.e.mi.com/doc/zh/marketing_api_guide.html); accounts are those the AM enabled for the app.
not_offered.get_report: No reporting endpoint is documented in the Marketing API guide (sections 一 申请创建外部应用 … 四 广告接口介绍: 广告计划, 广告组, 广告创意; https://global.e.mi.com/doc/zh/marketing_api_guide.html).
not_offered.pause_resume: No status field or pause/resume call is documented: 2.3 修改广告组 accepts only groupIds, regions, dayBudget and bid, and campaigns have only list/add (https://global.e.mi.com/doc/zh/marketing_api_guide.html).
